networks.name: HOME · CAPSULE 7B
networks.note: your flat's line. since the Registry pulled your key it reaches the building and nothing else.

networks.name: LIBRARY LAN
networks.note: the public library's own network. no line out: the books were the last thing it sent anywhere.
networks.need: inside the public library: its card reader, its printer

networks.name: THE PUBLIC NET
networks.note: street boxes, ads, timetables, the weather. everybody's, so nobody's.
networks.need: a public port on the street: a Registry box you control, the rooftop relay

networks.name: DELIVERY FLEET
networks.note: DISPATCH and the robots it routes. shields up, outside in.
networks.need: a delivery robot's uplink, or the public net

networks.name: FRIENDNET
networks.note: where friends post. the Registry reads it too; it says so in the terms.
networks.need: the public net, or a friend's own rig

networks.name: FLAT 4C
networks.note: Moth's own network. one way in, and it is not the door.
networks.need: FRIENDNET's link home, from Moth's own rig

programs.name: SCAN
programs.look: finds the machines a port can reach, and connects to them.
